evidence.title: Sheaf UI - Modern laravel and livewire Components

name: Sheaf UI
summary: Open-source component library of Laravel Blade, Alpine.js and Livewire components installed with a CLI.
description: Sheaf UI is a component library and design system for the TALL stack (Tailwind CSS, Alpine.js, Laravel, Livewire). Inspired by shadcn/ui, components are copied into your own codebase via an artisan CLI — no vendor package — with light/dark theming, design tokens, layouts and docs for every component.
contains: components: input, select, checkbox, date picker, button, card, dropdown, tabs, OTP, tooltip, accordion, toast
light/dark theming with Tailwind design tokens
components live in your codebase (no vendor package)
